content: Isa Mosir zormo
Hẽttiyaror din okkolot Rom dešor badša Agustusor hokum zari oiye, ze šara raijjor hár manuš okkolottu nam leka diya foribo.
Siriyar šašon goroya Kuronir ṭaimot ei foila bar manuš gona oiye.
Har mainše nam leka dibolla nizor nizor farat za šuru goijje.

Ar Yusuf aššilde badša Daudor bongšor manuš. Badša Daudor zormostan aššilde Ehudiya elehar Betlehem šohorot. Hetolla Yusuf o nam leka dibolla Galil elehar Nasarat farattu uwore Daudor šohor Betlehemot gil.
Moriyam, zar loi Yusufor biyar hotabattara ṭik oil, ar he šomot hiba hamil aššil, hibaye o Yusufor fũwati nam leka dibolla heṛe giye.
Hitara heṛe giyede šomot hibar fuwa halasi oibar ṭaim oiye.
Toi hibaye foila fuwa morod fuwa halasi goijje. Ar hibaye he fuware hoor berai di hanḍailot neṛai diye. Kiyollahoile hitaralla heṛe hiyan sara ar hono mikka takibar zaga no aššil.
Heṛe maṛot ḍakeduke hoekzon soolsoroya aššil, zara raitta soolor zãk fahara dil.
Ar Allar ek firista ai hitarar sarme hazir oiye. Toi Allar nuror tozolli sairo mikka oiye, henot soolsoroya okkole beši ḍoraiye.
Firistaye hitarare hodde, "No ḍoraiyo, kiyollahoile so, ãi tũwarare beši ḍõr kušir hóbor zanaito aišši; ei kuši hár manušolla oibo.
Kiyollahoile aziya Daudor šohorot tũwaralla ek basailoya zormo oiye; hiba oilde Mosi, Malik.
Ei hota soyide hiyanor sinno oilde, tũwara ek gura fuware hanḍailot hoor beraiya neṛaiya dekiba."
Bade atikka he firistar fũwati ek ḍõr firistar dol behostottu ai zug diye edde hitara beggune Allare ganor šure tarif gora šuru goijje:

content.text: edde duniyait hibar manuš okkolor maze,
zitarare loi Allah kuši hitarar uwore šanti ai ok!"

content: Firista okkol zehon hitarar henttu behostot giyegoi, soolsoroya okkole ekzone ekzonore hodde: "Aiyo, ãra Betlehem foijjonto zai, ze hota Allaye ãrare firistar duwara zanaiye hin saigoi."
Toi hitara toratori he zagat fõiššegoi, heṛe Moriyam edde Yusuf, hanḍailot neṛaiya he gura fuwar deha faiye.
Hitara he fuware deki bade he fuwar babute zin zin firistaye soolsoroya okkolore hoil hin hitara itarare zanai diye.
Ar zedun mainše soolsoroya okkolor hota fuinne, hitara beggune tajjuf oiye.
Kintu Moriyame he šob hota mone mone bafa šuru goijje edde hin nizor dilot gãti raikke.
Ar soolsoroya okkolore zendilla howa oil, hitara hendilla hár kissu deki funi Allare tarif edde šukuriya zaniye. Toi bade hitara henttu uwafes firi giyegoi.
Ašṭo din bade fuware azomi goraibar ṭaim oiye, ar hẽtte nam raka oiye Isa. Mar feṛot aibar age firistaye ei namman dil.
Fuwa Isare dórmogórot loigiye
Bade zehon Musar šoriyotot mozin pak saf oibar ṭaim oiye. Toi Yusuf edde Moriyame gura fuwa Isare Mabudor sarme tiya goraibolla Zeruzalemot loigiye.
Zendilla Mabudor ainot leka ase, "Foila zormor har morodore Mabudor dora oibo."
Hin bade o hitara kurbani goitto giye, zendilla ainot kurbani dibar hota leka ase: "Ek zura faikor so otóba duwa hoitoror basa."
Hẽtte Zeruzalemot Simeon name ekzon dórmiyo edde allawala manuš aššil. Allaye hõtte Israil zatir dukkore dur goribo he ṭaimolla hibaye sai aššil. Pak Ruh hibar uwore aššil,
ar Pak Ruhur duwara hibare batelai diya oi ze, Malik Messiyare no dekite hibar mout no oibo.
Toi hiba Pak Ruhor išara faiyore dórmogórot aišše. Ar zehon ma bafe fuwa Isare ainor rosom mozin furon goribolla dórmogóror butore ainne.
Simeonor Šukurana Gozol
Hetunot Simeone hibare fatarikula gori loiye edde Allar tarif gori hodde:

content.text: tũwar gulamore ehon šanti gori bidai goijjo,
kiyolla buli hoile ãr dui suke tũwar uddarore dekilam,
ziyan tũi har zatilla bebosta goijjo.
Oihudi okkolor hãse forhaš oibar nur,

content: Hibar babute hoiyede hin okkolot fuwar baf edde ma tajjuf oiye.
Ar Simeone hitarare duwa goijje edde Isar mare hodde: "Sa, ei fuwaye Israilor butore boutore tole felaibo edde uwore tulibo, ar iba en ek sinno oibolla aišše zar bifokke boute matibo.
Henot hitarar monor sinta forhaš oi zaiboi. Hin bade o, Moriyam tor dilot surir agator ḍoilla duk oibo."
Ar heṛe Hanna name ekzon maya fuwa nobi aššil, hiba aššilde Ašar bongšor Panuwelor zi, hibar umor beši oil. Hiba zuwan hale hãt bosor zamair gór gori bade,
aši sair bosor umor o foijjonto rari boni takkil. Ar hiba dórmogórot ruza edde munazat loi dine raite Allar ebadotot fori takito. Hibaye dórmogór sari hono mikka no zaitogoi.
He šomot Hannaye o heṛe aiyore šukuriya adai gora šuru goijje edde zedun manuš Zeruzalem azadir entezarot aiššil, hitarare hibaye Isar babute hoiye.
Toi hitara Mabudor ain mozin hár kissu fura gori bade Galil elehat, hitarar nizor fara Nasaratot firi giyegoi.
Ar fuwawa bari uiṭṭe edde mojbut oiye, giyane furaiya oiye, edde Allar rahamot hibar uwore aššil.
Isa baro bosojja taite dórmogórot
Uddar idor šomot Isar ma bafe fotti bosor Zeruzalem zaito.
Toi hiba zẽtte baro bosor oiye, hẽtte hitara hitarar idor niyom mozin uwore Zeruzalem giye;
Toi idor din okkol šeš oi bade, hitara firi zargoide šomot, fuwa Isa fissa Zeruzalem tai giyegoi, ar hibar baf maye hiyan no zanito.
Isa mainšor fũwati maze ase mone gori ek dinor fõtor baisa foijjonto hitara ai giyegoi. Bade hitara hitarar egena edde sina funa manuš okkolottu Isar talaš gora šuru goijje.
Hitara zehon Isare tuwai no fa, hitara Isare tuwaibolla uwafes firi Zeruzalem giye.
Šeše, tin din bade hitara Isare dórmogórot tuwai faiye. Isaye heṛe alem okkolor maze boi hitarar hota funat aššil edde hitarare suwal fusar goijjil.
Zara Isar hota fuinne hitara Isar ahol deki edde zuwab funi beggune tajjuf oiye.
Isar baf maye Isare deki ammuwak oiye. Maye Isare hodde: "Oh fut, tũi ãrar loi en kiyolla goijjo? Tũwar baf edde ãi hoto suhara oi tũware tuwa šuru goijjilam."
Kintu Isaye hodde:

content.text: "Tũwara kiyolla ãre talaš goijjila? Tũwara no zano ze ãttu ãr bafor górot taka foribo?"

content: Kintu Isaye hitarare ki hoiye hin hitara buzi no fare.
Tarfore Isa hitarar fũwati Nasarat uwafes firi giyegoi, edde baf mar hota mani soille. Isar maye in beggunore dilot gãti raikke.
Isa giyane edde boyoše bari uiṭṭe, Allah edde manušor adore.
